item.title: More fly tipping from Halligan Court residents, 2nd October
item.description:
For easily the 8th time this year the glorious residents at Hilligan Court have simply dumped their unwanted furniture out on the road. The biggest congratulations though should go to Bromley Council as despite this happening nearly a dozen times at the same property in 2026, they refuse to accept this is an issue and refuse to act, by even sending a simple polite letter asking them to stop. Well done Bromley council - another 20 mins of my time and my neighbours time we have had to waste due to your lack of acceptance of this issue and lack of proactivity. We have written to the local MP now about this as whilst this might seem trivial, it's the last attempt for you to do something before we all take a collective stance and begin planting our own rubbish on the street en masse. Not good enough. Again!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cowper Road, Widmore, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
